decisions.executionNote: Holder is on the right, pens on the left. Begin right-hand side-grasp approach with gradual wrist rotation and elbow-up continuity.
Advance right gripper toward holder from its right side, finishing inward-facing orientation; remain open above the table.
Previous chunk executed zero steps. Reduce approach and rotation increments to preserve joint continuity.
Continue right-side approach to holder body, slowly aligning jaws around it without crossing the arms.
Holder shifted during approach. Recenter right jaws on its visible body and close cautiously; retention not yet established.
Holder is not retained and has tipped. Open and lift clear, then shift toward its observed new location for recovery.
Align open right jaws with the fallen holder's near body, using the head and wrist views. Lower slowly before attempting a recovery pinch.
Recenter the recovery pinch slightly inward and toward the near side, above the table. Close on the holder body; next view must verify retention.
Test holder retention with a straight slow lift, maintaining closed right gripper and unchanged orientation.
Holder remained on the table. Change to an overhead recovery grasp, opening and lifting while rotating gradually above its body.
The previous act executed zero steps due to continuity rejection. Use substantially smaller increments to begin the overhead recovery orientation.
Continue gradual overhead alignment with open jaws, staying above the fallen holder.
Rotate toward a downward recovery grasp while shifting the right wrist over the fallen holder, with open jaws and constant clearance.
Align downward jaws across the holder's long axis, centering over the body for a top pinch. Maintain right-workspace wrist position.
Rotation was interrupted after six steps. Keep the latest orientation and use small downward/inward translations to seat the open jaws around the fallen holder.
Close the overhead pinch on the centered holder, pause to settle, then perform a small lift/retraction to check visible retention.
Holder appears to move with the closed overhead pinch. Lift and retract into the right workspace to create clearance before turning it upright.
The holder slipped and is on the table. Reopen, recenter over its new position, and lower farther for a deeper body pinch rather than a surface contact.
Seat the open jaws deeper and center the holder between them, then close while stationary before another retention test.
Test the deeper body pinch with a slow lift and slight retraction, keeping the holder clamped and its orientation unchanged.
The deeper pinch appears retained. Move the holder outward into the right workspace while gradually rotating its long axis toward upright, keeping the gripper closed.
Continue the retained holder's gradual uprighting rotation and move the wrist rightward for a stable handoff-free holding position.
Replan from the 13-step prefix. The holder is retained but still tilted left; apply much smaller rotation increments toward upright while preserving clearance.
Finish uprighting and lower the held cup to a practical insertion height. Begin a gradual left-hand overhead approach to the cyan pen, keeping arms on their own sides.
Hold the recovered cup steady at the observed pose after interruption. Continue left overhead alignment toward the cyan pen with gradual wrist rotation.
Align left jaws perpendicular to the cyan pen and advance above its upper body. Right hand keeps the upright holder steady.
Lower the open left jaws onto the cyan pen, correcting slightly along its upper body. Keep the recovered holder fixed and closed in the right hand.
Close on the cyan pen, pause for seating, then lift slightly to verify the pen follows the left gripper. Right holder remains stationary.
Cyan pen follows the left gripper. Lift clear and begin smoothly rotating it tip-up, moving toward the center without crossing arms.
Continue lifting and uprighting the cyan pen, approaching above the held cup with clearance for its rim.
Finish bringing the cyan pen upright and align its lower end over the cup opening, staying above the rim before descent.
Use a small near-side correction while lowering the now-upright cyan pen into the visible cup opening; keep both grasps closed.
The pen appears near the cup's near/right rim. Raise slightly, recenter toward the far side and left, then resume a shallow insertion without releasing.
Lower the centered cyan pen farther into the cup with a small far-side correction. Keep the right holder fixed and inspect before release.
Wrist view shows the cyan pen contacting the near rim rather than entering. Lift off the rim and shift toward the visible opening before another descent.
The cup opening is now centered beneath the cyan pen in both views. Descend vertically for insertion, keeping both grasps closed until the lower end is inside.
The cyan pen's lower end is over the dark cup interior. Release it, then withdraw left/up while the right hand holds the cup; verify it remains inside.
Cyan pen is visibly retained in the cup. Withdraw from the cup and begin orienting the left gripper for the purple pen's diagonal axis.
Previous chunk executed zero steps. Halve the wrist increments and retract gently at constant height to preserve joint continuity.
Continue rotating toward a downward grasp while approaching above the purple pen. Keep clear of the held cup and maintain right-hand closure.
Align the left gripper downward across the purple pen's length while descending to a clearance height. Right hand holds the upright cup with cyan pen retained.
Correct the purple pen's lateral offset using the wrist view and lower the open jaws to its body, keeping the cup still.
Purple pen is centered between the open jaws. Close, settle, then lift gently to verify retention before uprighting.
Purple pen follows the closed left gripper. Lift clear of the table and cup while beginning its uprighting rotation.
Raise the purple pen above cup height while continuing its gradual rotation toward upright and moving toward the opening.
Finish uprighting the purple pen and position its lower end above the open side of the cup beside cyan, before a vertical insertion.
Lower purple into the remaining space beside cyan, with a small leftward correction to avoid the already inserted pen. Keep the cup steady.
Purple tilted against cyan. Lift it clear, compensate its visible lean, and shift its lower end toward the vacant right side of the cup before reinserting.
Purple's lower end is again above the cup. Descend vertically with a slight rightward correction toward the empty portion, retaining both grasps.
Seat purple's lower end inside the opening, release it, and begin withdrawing left/up. Verify both pens remain in the upright held cup.
Withdraw the open left gripper clear of purple and cyan, then start the next overhead approach. Keep the holder clamped and watch that both inserted pens remain inside.
Move the left hand toward the yellow pen with gradual overhead rotation. Gently correct the holder's visible leftward lean while keeping it clamped.

Right rotation was interrupted after seven steps; lift/retract at its observed orientation to regain joint margin. Continue left overhead alignment. Purple is now visible on the table and will need recovery.
No steps executed in the last attempt. Use a smaller lift and a tiny orientation bridge toward the last accepted right target to satisfy continuity, while slowing the left approach.
Continue the left downward approach to yellow while lifting the held cup slightly for clearance and right-arm joint margin. Cyan remains in the cup; purple is on the table.
Complete the left downward alignment above yellow while descending gradually. Correct a little of the held cup's leftward lean with a small right-wrist rotation.
After the 11-step interruption, preserve the latest orientation and shift left/down toward the yellow pen rather than continuing the rejected rotation. Hold the cup at its observed pose.
Zero steps executed in the last attempt. Reduce translations to submillimeter increments to move away from the sensitive left-arm configuration without a joint jump.
With continuity restored, lower and shift the open left jaws laterally toward the yellow pen seen left of center in the wrist view. Preserve both arm configurations.
Make the remaining lateral correction to yellow, seat the jaws just above the table, and close while stationary. Retention must be checked on the next lift.
Let the yellow-pen pinch settle, then lift and retract gently without rotation to verify retention and gain elbow-up clearance.
Yellow remained on the table after the lift. Reopen and recenter the left grasp using the head-view pen midpoint, accounting for the tilted wrist-to-finger offset.
Yellow is still left of the jaw center in the wrist view. Correct perpendicular to its shaft at constant height, then close the centered pinch.
Yellow is centered in the pinch. Hold closed and lift/retract without rotating to check that it follows the hand.
Yellow follows the gripper. Lift above the cup and begin uprighting gradually, with the right-hand holder kept stationary.
Yellow slipped during rotation. Switch to the isolated black pen for a deeper centered grasp, opening and approaching from above while the cup remains held.
Lower the open left jaws around the black pen's upper-middle shaft, correcting leftward from the current wrist view. Keep holder and cyan steady.
Correct perpendicular to the black shaft at grasp height, then close and settle before lifting. Right hand maintains its holder grasp.
Settle the closed black-pen pinch, then lift and retract without rotation to verify retention before transfer.
Black pen follows the closed gripper. Lift clear and begin a gradual tip-up rotation while keeping the held cup stationary.
Continue lifting and uprighting the retained black pen while approaching above the held cup, leaving clearance from its rim.
Finish uprighting black and place its lower end above the cup opening, with enough height to avoid the rim and cyan.
Lower black's tip into the open space beside cyan without lateral motion. Keep both grasps closed and inspect the rim alignment before release.
Black contacted the rim/cyan and leaned. Lift its lower end with a small corrective rotation and move toward the far-side opening before descending again.
Black's lower end is clear and aligned over the vacant side of the holder. Lower slowly without changing its corrected orientation.
The right wrist view shows black's tip beyond the far side of the cup. Lift for clearance and shift toward the near side to center it over the opening.
Black's tip is now at cup depth alignment but left of the vacant center. Shift slightly right with clearance, then lower into the opening beside cyan.
Seat black slightly deeper, release it into the held cup, and withdraw left/up to check whether it remains inserted beside cyan.
Withdraw the fully open left hand well clear of the black pen and cup to verify insertion without contact; keep the right holder fixed.
Black remains in the held cup beside cyan. Begin an overhead approach to the yellow pen in its new table position, keeping clear of the inserted pens.
The previous approach executed zero steps due to left joint continuity. Halve all left increments and replan from the unchanged pose.
Continue rotating the open left hand down toward yellow while moving away from the cup opening. Both inserted pens remain visible in the holder.
